name: Trundle
title: The Troll King

abilities.name: King's Tribute
abilities.blurb: Innate: Enemies that die near  Trundle cause him to  heal based on their maximum health.

effects.description: Innate: Whenever a nearby enemy dies, Trundle heals himself for 1.8% - 5.94% (based on level) of their maximum health.

abilities.notes: King's Tribute does not trigger when an enemy structure is destroyed.

abilities.name: Chomp
abilities.blurb: Active:  Trundle's next  basic attack within a few seconds will deal bonus physical damage and briefly  slow the target.

effects.description: Active: Trundle empowers his next basic attack within 7 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and slow the target by 75% for 0.1 seconds.
After using the empowered attack, Trundle gains bonus attack damage for 5 seconds and reduces the target's bonus attack damage by half that amount for the same duration.
Chomp resets Trundle's basic attack timer.

abilities.notes:
Chomp will still incur the  attack damage increase for Trundle even if the attack is  dodged,  blocked, missed while he is  blinded, or it is blocked by  spell shield.
 Spell shield will only block the attack damage reduction and  slow.
If the attack damage reduction would reduce the target's bonus attack damage below 0, the target's base attack damage value is unaffected, but their total attack damage will still be reduced. The target will however retain a bonus attack damage value of 0.
Effects that scale with total attack damage, such as basic attacks, will take the attack damage reduction into account for their calculations.
Those that have a ratio for base attack damage or bonus attack damage do not take the reduction into account.

abilities.name: Frozen Domain
abilities.blurb: Active:  Trundle coats the target location in ice for a period. While he is within the area, he gains  bonus attack speed,  bonus movement speed, and increased  healing from all sources.

effects.description: Active: Trundle coats the target location in ice for 8 seconds. While he is within the area, he gains bonus attack speed, bonus movement speed, and 25% increased healing from all sources.

abilities.name: Pillar of Ice
abilities.blurb: Active:  Trundle erects an ice pillar at the target location that remains for a few seconds, which  knocks back units hit. The pillar acts as terrain and  slows nearby enemies.

effects.description: Active: Trundle erects a pillar of ice at the target location for 6 seconds, which knocks back units hit up to 225 units from its center. The pillar acts as terrain and slows nearby enemies.

abilities.notes:
Pillar of Ice displaces allied units away from the area but does not render them  airborne.
Allied  channels (e.g.  Recall,  Teleport) will be  interrupted however.
Pillar of Ice cannot be placed inside impassable terrain. Attempting to do so will cause the pillar to spawn in the nearest available spot of accessible terrain.
Pillar Of Ice triggers effects such as drawing turret aggro,  Sudden Impact and applying  Elixir of Sorcery by dealing 0  proc  true damage.

abilities.name: Subjugate
abilities.blurb: Active:  Trundle drains the life force of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage based on their maximum health and  healing for the same amount. He also steals a portion of their  armor and  magic resist, and increases in  size while reducing their  size.

effects.description: Active: Trundle drains the life force out of the target enemy champion, dealing magic damage and healing himself for the same amount. He also reduces 40% of their current armor and magic resistance, while gaining the same amount reduced as bonus armor and bonus magic resistance, respectively, for himself. Additionally, he increases in size by 18% while reducing the target's size by 9.9%.

Half of the drain's total damage, healing, and resistances reduction is applied on-cast, while the other half is applied every second over the next 4 seconds. The size modifiers last for 8 seconds and are applied over the first 2.25 seconds of the duration, both increasing Trundle's size by 2% and reducing the target's size by 1.1% every 0.25 seconds.
The resistances reduction on the target will linger for 4 seconds after the drain has ended.

abilities.notes:
Subjugate deals  persistent damage, additionally tagged as  indirect damage, and applies  spell effects.
Subjugate will snapshot the values of the target's current maximum health, total armor, and total magic resistance as soon as it completes its cast. The drain debuff will calculate the remaining half of the damage, healing, and resistances reduction based on these snapshotted values, even if the target's health or resistances change. The snapshot lasts until the debuff expires.
The target's resistances will be further reduced by 5% per drain tick, up to 20% by the end of the drain (totaling to 40% reduction from the initial 20% reduction on-cast).
Trundle will gain the reduced resistances of the target for himself for as long as they remain reduced, including while they are lingering after the drain.
The resistances gained is based on the current reduced resistances of the target; the total amount that would be reduced is not granted to Trundle all at once. In other words, he will initially gain 20% of the target's resistances, then the remaining 20% over the 4 seconds, gaining additional bonus resistances equal to the resistances reduced per drain tick.
Trundle gains 11.7 extra  range on his  basic attacks (relative to his and enemy center) as a consequence of his increased  size.
So do his enemies.
He gains 3.78 to 6.255 range against the target he subjugated, depending on their base size, and so does the target against him.
The debuff on the target also persists through death.
Trundle will lose the buff if the target loses the debuff, for example if it enters  resurrection.(unexpected)
If the target becomes  untargetable,  dies, or is too far away or no longer in  sight during the cast time, this ability will cancel but does not go on  cooldown nor pay its cost (if applicable).

lore: Trundle is a hulking and devious troll with a particularly vicious streak, and there is nothing he cannot bludgeon into submission—not even the Freljord itself. Fiercely territorial, he chases down anyone foolish enough to enter his domain. Then, his massive club of True Ice at the ready, he chills his enemies to the bone and impales them with jagged, frozen pillars, laughing as they bleed out onto the tundra.
